cues: The four fourth roots of unity, one, minus one, i and minus i, under multiplication.
Every product stays in the set; one is the identity; i and minus i are inverses.
Another abelian group of order four.
Remember the cold open: multiplying by i is a quarter turn, just like the four hour clock.
